review.proofing.spelling.note: U:prism/spelling: opens the Spelling pane (panes/spelling.tsx, review.spelling, F7) on the first misspelt or repeated word on or after the current slide, going to its slide and shape: Ignore, Ignore All, Add (to the dictionary), the suggestions, Change, Change All and Delete for a repeated word. Words are checked against the bundled US English dictionary (nspell over dictionary-en, core/common/lib/spelling.mjs); text in another language, or marked do-not-check, is left out. Squiggles under the misspelt words of the slide's shapes and table cells (not in the notes box, a plain text field: the notes are read by the pane) and the right-click menu on one: U:prism/spelling.

review.proofing.thesaurus.note: U:prism/review: shows or hides the Thesaurus pane (panes/thesaurus.tsx): a search box, the senses and synonyms of the word, a click inserts the synonym while editing text.

review.accessibility.check.note: U:prism/review: opens the Accessibility Checker dialog (dialog.accessibility): a slide without a title, a picture, chart, media or group without alternative text, text hard to read on a solid background, each with Go to. Hidden: Keep Accessibility Checker running while I work (deckcraft checks on demand).

review.insights.search.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no Smart Lookup (Search) and the app does not look words up online.

review.language.translate.note: Hidden: deckcraft's Translate is a disabled button (it needs a language model that is not bundled).

review.comments.new.note: U:prism/review: opens the New Comment dialog (dialog.comment); the comment goes on the current slide, pointing at the selected shape, and the Comments pane shows it.

items.label: Delete All Comments in This Presentation

review.comments.delete.note: U:prism/review: Delete removes the comment the pane or Next / Previous last went to (else every comment of the slide); the menu also deletes every comment of the slide or of the presentation.

review.comments.show.note: U:prism/review: shows or hides the Comments pane (panes/comments.tsx); on while it is open.

review.compare.compare.note: U:prism/review: the system Open dialog picks the revised copy (a .pptx); the Revisions pane opens with the slide-level differences (review.compare).

items.label: Accept All Changes to the Presentation

review.compare.accept.note: U:prism/review: Accept All takes every revision into the open presentation; one revision at a time is accepted in the Revisions pane. Hidden: Accept Change and Accept All Changes to This Slide (deckcraft accepts per revision in the pane only).

items.label: Reject All Changes to the Presentation

review.compare.reject.note: U:prism/review: Reject All drops every revision without applying it; one at a time in the Revisions pane.

review.compare.previous.note: U:prism/review: PowerPoint's Previous Change: goes to the slide of the previous revision still to review (not checked against upstream).

review.compare.next.note: U:prism/review: PowerPoint's Next Change: goes to the slide of the next revision still to review (not checked against upstream).

review.compare.pane.note: U:prism/review: shows or hides the Revisions pane (panes/revisions.tsx).

review.ink.hide.note: U:prism/review: PowerPoint's Hide Ink: the ink on the slides is not drawn in the editor and the slide list (not checked against upstream).

dialog.comment.note: U:prism/review: the comment text; Post adds it to the current slide (comment.add). PowerPoint posts inline in the Comments pane; deckcraft uses this dialog.

dialog.spelling.note: U:prism/review: replaced by the Spelling pane (U:prism/spelling); the ribbon, F7 and the Quick Access Toolbar open the pane, and the old list dialog has no model, so nothing reaches it.

dialog.accessibility.note: U:prism/review: drawn by src/apps/prism/dialogs/accessibility.tsx over review.accessibility (the list is live); Close closes it. Not offered: the Errors / Warnings / Tips grouping and Keep Accessibility Checker running (nothing upstream).
